segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are sharply divided: many report a gentle, non-irritating cleanse that leaves skin calm and hydrated, while several others describe burning, stinging, or red irritation bumps, particularly around the eyes.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the product removes makeup without stripping moisture or leaving tightness, and one calls it perfect for dry skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer identifies as dry-combo sensitive acne-prone skin and reports it removed all makeup gently and effectively.
segments.mature: No specific mentions of mature skin are found in these reviews.

concerns.aging: Not addressed by reviewers; no comments on fine lines, firmness, or wrinkles were found.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the product does not dry out or strip skin, leaving it hydrated and soft after use; one reviewer specifically praises it as non-drying compared to other cleansers.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the product leaves red, irritation-marked bumps on sensitive skin, though most other sensitive-skin reviewers report no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers state it improves or repairs a damaged skin barrier and leaves skin balanced; no reviewer reports barrier damage from use.
concerns.spots: Not clearly addressed; no reviewer specifically discusses dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some describe breakouts clearing or healing over time; one reviewer reports the opposite, that her skin was clear until she started using it and it caused issues.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with large pores or excess sebum report the product removes excess oil, minimizes pore appearance, and leaves skin smooth rather than greasy.

extraits.texte: I bought this because I have extremely sensitive skin and micellar water generally works well as a cleanser for me. This claims to be for sensitive skin, but it burns and leaves little red bumps (irritation marks) around my face. I should have stuck with what I knew but took a shot with this and highly regret it. I gave it two stars because it may work for others who aren't as sensitive as I am.

I find this cleanser really irritates my eyes, almost a burning sensation. I've worked up with puffy, stinging eyes the past few days, with this as the only new addition to my routine. It also doesn't cleanse! I don't wear a ton of makeup, but even so, it took several damp cotton balls of this to make a dent.

⭐️ I received this Pure Cleansing Water Sensitive for free from Manyo and Picky. 💜First off you get a huge 16.9 Fl oz bottle. This will definitely last you awhile and is very reasonably priced. Its texture/color is literally like water, no sticky feeling, and has no scent at all. I actually used this a couple different ways. To remove makeup, and to cleanse in my double cleanse routine. As a makeup remover it did remove most makeup, but it did leave some of my stubborn waterproof makeup behind. Now as a regular cleanser is where I felt it really shined and my preferred use. It definitely exfoliated my skin by removing any excess sebum, so it made my skin very smooth. I have large pores; and it penetrated deep into them to thoroughly clean, and made them unnoticeable. It never dried out my skin and made it very hydrated. Along with never breaking me out, so it really is great for sensitive skin. It never even burned my eyes when I went over them! With some cleansing/micellar water they leave a film behind, and this product did not. I use this as my 2nd cleanse after my oil based face wash/cleanser. Water based products should be last in your cleansing routine. I love the way my skin feels and looks using this. It also was easy to apply onto a cotton swab. I will definitely continue to use this and highly recommend it! ❌The only negative and reason why I deducted 1 star is that I wish it removed all my makeup. extraits.texte: My sensitive skin really likes this! The makeup removers from Garnier and Bioderma did not work best for my skin, so I tried this. Game changer!! It is very gentle and gets all of my makeup off. 10/10 recommend. I have dry-combo sensitive acne prone skin.

This product is amazing. I have sensitive skin and any other cleansing water I have ever used leaves me with dry patches around my mouth forehead and nose. I cant attest to its ability to remove makeup on its own because I only ever use it after cleansing but it does a great job at removing anything left over and leaving my skin feeling clean, fresh, and still hydrated. It also has no strong scent, which wouldnt bother me personally but I know that it is important to many. A perfect addition to my skincare routine. You will not regret, especially for the price and the amount of product!
